summary: The update adds an optional Pre-Vote round to OpenRaft (pre_candidate state, SendPreVote/RequestPreVote/PreVoteResponse, a timer Pre-Vote branch, trigger().elect(pre_vote)), so the model had to change (MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED). I updated base/MC/Trace, added Update.tla/UpdateProps.tla with focused, open, and discharge views, and repaired three model defects that predated this update: (1) empty last-log ids compared unequal, which made 3-voter elections unreachable in the V0 MC.cfg; (2) a new Leader's lease after establish_leader; (3) tick guards. I rebased the V0 harness. 21 fresh traces from the updated implementation (7 V0 reruns, 14 update scenarios) pass TLC trace validation with TraceConsumed, and all 20 single-field mutants are rejected. Model checking is bounded and budget-limited (LIMITED_COVERAGE). All 8 reachability canaries were hit, and 4 regression mutants were detected. Model checking found two update-introduced defects, both reproduced through the public Raft API in debug and release builds. MC-1: Pre-Vote responses are matched to rounds only by leader id, and every round at one term shares that id, so a later round counts a grant from an earlier one. If the responder was removed in between, Candidate::grant_by panics and RaftCore stops. MC-2: a Pre-Vote round started while the node is a Candidate survives establish_leader, and when its quorum arrives the new Leader starts another election (term inflation, leadership loss; debug builds also panic on try_leader_handler's assertion). CR-1 is a documentation-only inconsistency in pre_vote.md and is not a code defect. CI verdict: FAIL.
